name: Rippling
feed: GET https://ats.rippling.com/api/v2/board/rippling/jobs?page=0&pageSize=1000 (one row per job x location; group by id). Alternative: GET https://api.rippling.com/platform/api/ats/v1/board/rippling/jobs (bare array, same rows)
page_total_how: Playwright render of https://www.rippling.com/careers/open-roles (2026-10-20T00:08Z) showed '656 roles across all departments in all locations': the page lists one card per job x location (Algolia index careers_en-US_production, nbHits 656). The board API returned the same 656 rows (v1 and v2) at 00:09Z = 377 unique job ids.
notes: Rows are per location: dedupe by id and merge locations[]. Titles carry stray leading/trailing spaces. Two 'Internal Posting — …' titles contain 'Intern' as a substring, so match whole words only. Algolia briefly held one stale closed job (660 rows at 23:53Z), so prefer the board API.
